name: librephotos-monorepo
description: Root npm workspace for the mobile app. Only packages/* and apps/mobile are workspaces here; apps/frontend and apps/docs keep their own independent installs (Yarn) and are intentionally excluded so this file does not disturb them.
//expo-router: Declared here ONLY to force npm to hoist expo-router into the root node_modules. The Expo CLI hoists to the root, but npm otherwise nests apps/mobile's expo-* packages, so the root CLI's typed-route generator cannot resolve 'expo-router/_ctx-shared' and `expo start` crashes outright (experiments.typedRoutes). Keep this in lockstep with the expo-router version in apps/mobile (SDK 57 -> ~57.0.22).
//expo: expo is pinned here for the same reason, and to the SAME range as apps/mobile. expo-router peer-depends on `expo: "*"`; with no pin npm satisfies that peer with the LATEST expo at the root while the app's own copy gets nested, so the repo root ends up with a newer Expo CLI than the app it is supposed to run. Bump this together with the SDK.
//react: react/react-dom are pinned here to the SAME versions apps/mobile uses. Without the pin, npm resolves expo-router's optional react-dom peer to the newest 19.x, which peer-requires a newer react than the app's and conflicts -- npm then refuses to hoist. 19.2.3 is not arbitrary: it is the React version Expo SDK 57 / react-native 0.86 ships with, and jest-expo@57 pins react-test-renderer@19.2.3 while jest-expo hard-fails if react-test-renderer does not match react exactly. Keep all of these in lockstep with apps/mobile/package.json.
//overrides: expo-router is installed at the root (see above), and npm auto-installs its open-ended peers (react-native: *, react-native-screens: *, react-native-safe-area-context: >= 5.4.0, react-native-reanimated/worklets via @expo/ui) at the LATEST version there. That gave the root a newer copy than apps/mobile pins (react-native 0.87 next to the app's 0.86), so the bundle and the type checker saw two copies of the native modules. These overrides force one copy each, at the versions Expo SDK 57 bundles. Bump them together with the SDK.
